description: Public color despeckling removes isolated per-face noise while preserving ties, uncoloured boundaries, pass-zero control, and face-order independence.

mutants.description: A tied blue self vote and red neighbour must retain blue; selecting a tied neighbour and accepting equality would recolour the centre.
The public classic path must honor an explicit zero-pass request; forcing one pass erases the isolated blue control. The helper's own passes <= 0 guard makes this a meaningful call-site mutation.
Uncoloured boundary triangles are not votes; allowing -1 into the candidate counts would erase the tied centre.
The filter must snapshot every face's prior colour. Initializing all faces from the first face breaks both the expected palette and reordered-face comparison.
